name: comment-deslop
description: De-slop the comments an agent just wrote. A PostToolUse hook intersects tree-sitter comment nodes with the git-changed lines and reports 13 slop rules (restatement, flow narration, history/decision recording, process leaks, benchmarks, stale references, verbosity, per-function comment budget, redundant docstrings); /deslop then fixes them. Offline, no model call, never edits a file itself.
